notes.title: Sorcery Pack DLC and Update 7 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hayo Park Managers! 

It's time to sprinkle some magic across your parks - the [url="https://www.planetcoaster.com/dlc/sorcery-pack"]Sorcery Pack DLC[/url] is available now for Planet Coaster 2 on all platforms.[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="7NX07wlqAiU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Delve into a magical world full of mystery and wonder with this pack, containing:[/p][p][/p][p]FIVE new spellbinding customisable attractions - OUTAMAX - Bike and Sidecar Coaster, VECTOR - Child Coaster, Flying Theatre flat ride, Gale Force flat ride and the highly-requested OUTAMAX - LSM Raid Coaster[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100725/363755661cd8e25135a22506ed66f85ddcdf9e35.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]HUNDREDS of Sorcery-themed scenery pieces - including animatronics that will really enchant your guests![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100725/a5b00b144aa6a3bd5991a03d139d080427fe47ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]PLUS, a brand-new magical Entertainer - Vesper[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100725/a2cb61376cb70a29d4234e120e684b9a85fef1d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Bring the magic to your parks now, with the Sorcery Pack DLC for Planet Coaster 2[/p][p][/p][h1][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3902620/Planet_Coaster_2_Sorcery_Pack/" style="button" buttoncolor="#ffa400"]BUY NOW[/url][/h1][p][/p][p]Alongside this DLC launch, we've also released Update 7. This FREE update is available to all Planet Coaster 2 players across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][p]Update 7 includes a number of new features as well as bug fixes and improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]UPDATE 7 - NEW FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2][h3][b]Challenge Mode[/b][/h3][p]Test your ability to run a successful theme park in this brand-new game mode. Choose from sandbox biomes or career sandbox templates as a starting point and complete challenges to gain cash rewards and continue levelling up your park.[/p][p]You'll even be able to convert your challenge park into a sandbox park, so you can continue building, customising and improving your dream theme park![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Grid Based System [/b][/h3][p]We've implemented a new 3-axis grid system, so you can now rotate buildings on all three axis and add some really unique touches to your park![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100725/19f8c8bcb59b7a4fcc24dded3a04b633fc6ba759.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Path Tool Improvements[/b][/h3][p]We've made some changes to the pathing tools in Update 7. Check out our Highlights Video![/p][previewyoutube="MrnVUxUFgdU;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]For full details on everything that's included, please refer to our[url="https://www.planetcoaster.com/updates/1-7-0"] Update Notes.[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Update 6 is here!
notes.notes: [h2][b]Hayo Park Managers![/b][/h2][p]Our next major release, Update 6 is out now![/p][p][/p][p]This update includes modular souvenir shops, on-ride photos, Pirate and Fairytale themes, additional moving platform options, and a returning flat ride from the original Planet Coaster. We've also included a number of fixes and adjustments to make your gameplay experience even better![/p][p]Please read below for a breakdown of what's in Update 6.[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Modular souvenir shops[/b][/p][list][*][p]Build and open your own modular souvenir shops![/p][/*][*][p]Cash registers and shelves can be connected to modular souvenir shops.[/p][/*][*][p]Vendors work behind the cash register counter, serving guests.[/p][/*][*][p]Customise each shelf by setting different merchandise from the shop menu options.[/p][/*][*][p]Small and large modular souvenir shop blueprints are also available in the Planet Coaster theme.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]On-ride photos[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ride cameras can now be placed on coasters to take photos of guests.[/p][/*][*][p]Ride cameras can then be linked to a photo kiosk shop or counter so the pictures can be bought by guests.[/p][/*][*][p]Custom billboards can use an on-ride photo as a source, where they can be viewed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Returning themes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Pirate theme[/b][/p][list][*][p]Update 6 will bring Pirate themed static and animated scenery objects to parks as well as Pirate themed music, triggered SFX and ambient audio tracks.[/p][/*][*][p]Pirate themed fonts are also included for players to further customise their signs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fairytale theme[/b][/p][list][*][p]Update 6 will bring Fairytale themed static and animated scenery objects to parks as well as Fairytale themed music, triggered SFX and ambient audio tracks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fairytale themed fonts are also included for players to further customise their signs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Standard ‘de-themed’ coasters[/b][/p][list][*][p]The standard versions of 2 more coaster rides will be included:[/p][/*][*][p]Big M's Rides - Water Coaster[/p][/*][*][p]Movement Construction - Mine Train[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Returning ride[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fully rebuilt for Planet Coaster 2, the flat ride Coriolis is returning from the original game as part of Update 6, ready for you to customise and for your guests to enjoy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Career Mode Sandbox maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pre-made maps from Career mode Act 4 will be added to Sandbox mode as a starting point for creative projects.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Moving platforms[/b][/p][list][*][p]More animation types have been added for rotational, horizontal, and vertical moving platforms: Very Fast, Ultra Fast, Very Slow, Ultra Slow.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New profile and Franchise stickers[/b][/p][list][*][p]20 New profile stickers have been added for you to further customise your profile.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Increased blueprint piece count limit[/b][/p][list][*][p]The limit for the total number of pieces in a blueprint has been increased from 4000 to 8000.[/p][/*][*][p]Multi-Select tools limit has been increased from 5000 to 10,000.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Refinements have been made to improve the flow of both tutorial levels 'Keys to the Coaster' and 'In the Swim of Things'.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Placeable speakers - volume sliders[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players will now be able to control the volume of individual speakers within their park.[/p][/*][*][p]This is controlled by a new slider that has been added to the Info Panel of each placeable speaker.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Music Playlists[/b][/p][list][*][p]15 pre-made playlists have been added to the music selection on rides and speakers.[/p][/*][*][p]These playlists span across the existing genres and themes in game, including Fairytale and Pirate![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Additional Audio Settings Sliders[/b][/p][list][*][p]The following volume sliders have been added to the audio settings, allowing players to control their game mix to their preference: Ambience, Tracked Rides, Flat Rides, Waterparks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p]We are continuing to review all your feedback and reports and will announce new updates and fixes when they are ready. [b][url="https://issues.frontierstore.net/issue-detail/76213"]View on Issue Tracker[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed various other crashes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 5 is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hayo Park Managers![/h2]
Our next major update, [b]Update 5[/b], is [b]now here[/b]!

This update includes [b]Security Guards and Crime[/b], [b]Sci-Fi themed scenery pieces[/b], [b]colour customisation[/b] for glass, rocks, flume inflatables and mats, improvements to path tools, and a returning coaster inspired by the original Planet Coaster. We've also included a number of fixes and adjustments to make your gameplay experience even better!

Please read below for a breakdown of what's in Update 5.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[b]Security & Crime[/b]
[list][*]New Staff type: [b]Security Guard[/b]
[*]New guest behaviour: [b]criminality[/b]
[*]Pickpockets will now enter parks looking to steal from unsuspecting guests and flee from Security Guards once spotted.
[*]If guests are unhappy for too long, park managers might find themselves dealing with a vandalism problem too.
[*]Players can now add Security Guards and Cameras to their parks to prevent crime and apprehend Criminals.[/list]

[b]Sci-Fi Theme[/b]
[list][*]Sci-Fi themed static and animated scenery objects
[*]Sci-Fi themed music, triggered SFX and ambient audio tracks
[*]New Sci-Fi themed billboard videos[/list]

[b]Glass Panels and Customisation[/b]
[list][*]Colour customisation options for glass scenery pieces
[*]New glass panel shapes (with and without frames):
[list]
[*]Circle
[*]Hexagon
[*]Octagon
[*]Semi Circle
[*]Triangle
[*]Long Triangle[/list][/list]

[b]Rock Customisation[/b]
[list][*]New 'custom rock' scenery pieces with colour customisation[/list]

[b]Inflatable Customisation[/b]
[list][*]Colour customisation for flume inflatables and mats[/list]

[b]Path Tool Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Invisible paths
[*]Toggle kerbs and path foundations
[*]Circular stamps for paths and pools
[*]New area delete tool
[*]Customisable coaster stations and flume platforms
[*]Reduced minimum height for paths over pools/paths[/list]

[b]Standard 'De-themed' Coasters[/b]
[list][*]High Peaks Construction - Wooden Hybrid Steel Rails
[*]High Peaks Construction - Wooden Hybrid Steel Topped
[*]Decorative pieces from these coasters added as individual scenery[/list]

[b]Returning Ride[/b]
[list][*][b]Vector - Return Mk II[/b], inspired by the Trident coaster from the original game[/list]

[b]Career Mode Sandbox Maps[/b]
[list][*]Pre-made maps from Career mode Act 3 added to Sandbox mode[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[b]Western Theme Additions[/b]
[list][*]9 half-width non-grid wall pieces
[*]4 roof pieces[/list]

[b]Ride Prestige Adjustments[/b]
[list][*]Clear breakdown of ride impact on prestige
[*]Full prestige score now includes ride experience and scenery bonus
[*]Classic ride prestige threshold increased to 800
[*]Simplified UI: only shows scenery bonus
[*]Updated help screens[/list]

[b]Ride Reputation Adjustments[/b]
[list][*]New 'Established' stage between 'New' and 'Dated'
[*]Appeal bonus/penalties displayed at each stage
[*]Prestige impact explained in ride info panel
[*]Updated stage icons and help screens[/list]

[b]Guest Moods[/b]
[list][*]Guest mood reasoning now shown in infopanel[/list]

[b]Water Rides Visuals[/b]
[list][*]Enhanced visuals for:
[list][*]Big M's Rides - Narrow Log Flume
[*]FD Vision - Steam Boat
[*]FD Vision - Wide Log Flume
[*]Outamax - River Rapids
[*]Big M's Rides - Water Coaster
[*]F&N Thriller Industries - Antique Water Coaster
[*]Outamax - Water Coaster (pre-order bonus)[/list][/list]

[b]Career Messaging[/b]
[list][*]Improved messaging for career scenario completion[/list]

[b]Light Activation Settings[/b]
[list][*]Lights can now override night-only setting[/list]

[b]Special Piece Tooltips[/b]
[list][*]Tooltip descriptions added to track and flume special pieces
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
We are continuing to review all your feedback and reports and will announce new updates and fixes when they are ready. In the meantime, please continue to report any bugs on our [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]Issue Tracker[/url].

[b]Audio[/b]
[list][*]Music from other nearby trains will no longer be heard when riding onboard coasters. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url]
[*]Resolved an issue where soundtrack music would fade out when near music sources muted in settings. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url][/list]

[b]Coasters & Rides[/b]
[list][*]Resolved an issue preventing track supports from being drawn on some parts of Grand Coasters Worldwide coasters. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url]
[*]Flume supports will now appear more consistently on flume pieces that are close to the ground. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url]
[*]Adjusted the alignment between car wheels and track on the Vector - Sit Down - 4 Seater coaster. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url]
[*]Resolved resolution issue on Outamax - Sit Down - 4 Seater - Brake track piece. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url]
[*]Resolved an issue causing freecam to become inaccessible during coaster creation. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url][/list]

[b]Guests[/b]
[list][*]Resolved issues around guests not using Sun Loungers. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url]
[*]Guests will now interact more frequently with lazy rivers. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url][/list]

[b]Park Construction[/b]
[list][*]Adjusted the names of cuboid scenery shapes to match the object. - [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/]View on Issue Tracker[/url][/list]

[b]Stability[/b]
[list][*]Fixed various other crashes, including a work-around for certain instances of the AMD driver-related crashes affecting some players. We are continuing to work with AMD to investigate this issue further.[/list]

notes.title: Update 4 is here!
notes.notes:
Hayo Park Managers!

[h3]Update 4 is available now!
[/h3]
This update includes restaurants, colour customisation for pools, Workshop and Franchise enhancements, and more. We've also included a number of fixes and adjustments to make your gameplay experience even better!

Please read below for a breakdown of what's in Update 4.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[h3][*] Restaurants[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will now be able to build and open restaurant facilities!
[*] Benches and tables can be connected to restaurants.
[*] Vendors serve food and drink from a counter, guests will take their meal on a tray to a table.
[*] Customise each menu by setting different ingredients from the menu options.
[*] A restaurant blueprint per Planet Coaster 2 theme will be available (Planet Coaster, Viking, Resort, Aquatic and Mythology) as well as a dining booth, table, and restaurant related signs.
[/list]

[h3][*] Workshop enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The main menu Workshop tab is getting some additional sections to show off more of the amazing work from our community. These are:

[list]
[*][b]"Featured Creators"[/b]
[*][b]"Featured Creations"[/b][/list]
[*] Players will now be able to follow their favourite Workshop creators and stay up to date with all of their uploads via a new Workshop screen.[/list]


[h3][*] Pool colour customisation options[/h3]
[list][*]In Update 4, players will now be able to further customise their water parks using some extra colour options for pools. This includes:

[*] Colour customisation options for pool water.
[*] "Colour Strength" and "Lighting Glow" sliders for pool water.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]🎉 UPDATE 3 IS HERE! 🎉[/h2]

[list][*] Enhanced flume behaviours
[*] Career Mode Sandbox maps
[*] Western theme returns
[*] More coasters[/list]
...and loads of fixes & adjustments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100725/1365bbf6a7898e17092dadae451d33b082e29265.jpg[/img]

Please see below for the full list of changes.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]

[b]Enhanced flume behaviours[/b][list]

[i]Please note that existing flumes will need to turn the ‘Enhanced Guest Flume Behaviours' toggle on to see the new flume behaviours. Existing flumes in your parks may also be affected visually due to clipping with the new round bottomed flumes - adjustments to your flume placement will resolve this.
Newly placed flumes will use the new flume behaviours toggle by default.[/i]

[*]As part of Update 3, all flumes bottoms are now rounded, and inflatables will deform to match this shape as they slide down! 
[*]Your guests will also enjoy a number of new ways to travel down the flume special pieces. Depending on their entry speed onto the piece, there will be different directions their raft could take! You will need to toggle ‘Enhanced Guest Flume Behaviours’ on to see this.  
[*]Flume jettisoning will also be making its way to the game, with guests reacting to it. Although Jettison looks fun, guests might have a different opinion as they go through the experience and there will be negative reactions from it if they don’t land in water. Panic will overwhelm your guest, and they will leave the park. 
[*]On top of the above, we will be making further enhancements to physics and guests behaviours.[/list]  

[b]Career Mode Sandbox maps[/b][list]
[*]Pre-made maps from the Career Tutorial and Act 1 will be added to Sandbox Mode to give you a starting point and get your creative juices flowing! [/list]

[b]Standard ‘de-themed’ coasters[/b][list] 
[*]We are adding standard versions of the Outamax - Launched Hydraulic and Vector – Sit Down Launched New Gen, so you can express more of your creativity and make these coasters your own! The Airplane and Racing Car pieces from these coasters will also be available to use as scenery items for your park and rides.[/list]

[b]Returning coaster[/b][list]
[*]The Vector - Inverted Suspended is making a comeback from the original Planet Coaster. This thrilling ride has been fully rebuilt for Planet Coaster 2 for you to customise and for your guests to enjoy![/list]

[b]Returning theme [/b][list]
[*]Yee-haw! Customise your park with the returning Western theme, counting more than 350 scenery pieces. These include building props, animatronics and wall sets inspired by the untamed Wild West. [/list]

[PC ONLY] [b]Custom audio for rides[/b][list]
[*][PC ONLY] Make your attractions feel even more unique by importing your own .ogg, .mp3, .wav, .wma, .aac, .m4a and .flac audio files to existing rides.[/list]

[h2]UPDATES[/h2]

[b]RANDOM SCALING AND ROTATION TOGGLE FOR SCENERY PIECES[/b][list]
[*]Added toggles for all non-animated scenery items[/list]

[b]TRANSPARENT FLUME PIECES[/b][list]
[*]Added transparent start pieces and end pieces[/list]

[*]Unscheduled, roaming Ride Attendants will now proactively perform handovers

[b]ECONOMY BALANCING[/b][list]
[*]More responsive pricing for Priority Passes 
[*]Guest population is now more consistent and is more responsive to Park Rating 
[*]Pool and Priority Passes can now be refunded to unhappy guests 
[*]Pools now only affect Park Rating once they hit a certain minimum size 
[*]Park Scenery Rating is directly linked to the guest’s visual experience – more Scenery pieces in their line of sight means a better Scenery Rating for your Park[/list]

[b]MULTI-SELECT TOOL[/b][list]
[*]The item selected when entering Multi-Select is now retained as part of the selection

notes.title: Update 3 Highlights
notes.notes:
Hayo Park Managers!

Update 3 arrives on March 20th for all Planet Coaster 2 players to enjoy and we're here to give you a sneak peek at some of the biggest features, additions and enhancements coming.

[previewyoutube=r9A3ZZJVNnM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Features[/h2]
Please note that existing flumes will need to turn the ‘Enhanced Guest Flume Behaviours' toggle on to see the new flume behaviours. Existing flumes in your parks may also be affected visually due to clipping with the new round bottomed flumes - adjustments to your flume placement will resolve this.

Newly placed flumes will use the new flume behaviours toggle by default.

[h3]Enhanced flume behaviours[/h3][list]
[*] Flume bottoms are now rounded as part of Update 3 and inflatables will deform to match this shape as they slide down!
[*] Your guests will also enjoy more variation in how they travel down the flume special pieces, determined by their entry speed into the piece! You will need to toggle ‘Enhanced Guest Flume Behaviours’ on to see this.
[*] Flume jettisoning also makes its way into Planet Coaster 2, with tight corners and bumps at high speed ejecting guests into the air! Although it is fun to watch people and rafts go flying, this will impact your guests’ happiness.
[*] In addition to the above, Update 3 also features general enhancements to physics and guests behaviours on flumes.[/list]
[h3]Career Mode Sandbox maps[/h3][list]
[*] Pre-made maps from the Career Tutorial and Act 1 have been added to Sandbox Mode to give you a starting point and get your creative juices flowing![/list]
[h3]Returning theme[/h3][list]
[*] Yee-haw! Customise your park with the returning Western theme, featuring more than 350 scenery pieces. These include building props, animatronics and wall sets inspired by the untamed Wild West[/list]
[h3]Rides[/h3]
We’re bringing you more standard “de-themed” versions of coasters to put your own creative spin on:

[list][*] The Vector – Sit Down Launched New Gen
[*] The Outamax – Launched Hydraulic[/list]

The plane and racing car inspired pieces from these coasters can now also be used separately as standard scenery pieces!

We're also pleased to bring back another ride from the original Planet Coaster, introducing the return of the thrilling [b]Vector - Inverting Suspended[/b], which will turn your guests upside down (quite literally!)

[h2]Adjustments and Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multi-Select tool UI enhancements
[*] Improvements to staff scheduling
[*] Tweaks to park economy
[*] Many bug fixes and improvements, including crash fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100725/911f245f2598b0d65451ef351e48c21ae92ac07e.jpg[/img]

This is just a glimpse at what's included in Update 3 - if you'd like to dive into all the details, [url=https://www.planetcoaster.com/updates/1-3-1]visit the full changelog[/url] for the nitty-gritty!

We also recently shared an [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2688950/announcements/detail/538847639944298692?snr=2___]updated look at our Spring roadmap for Planet Coaster 2[/url], including some details on what you can expect in Update 4. We'll be sharing even more details (and maybe even an exclusive first look) on this month's Frontier Unlocked, airing [b]Wednesday 26th March at 6pm GMT[/b].

As always we're incredibly grateful for all your continued support and feedback - if you're continuing to experience any issues, do please continue to report any bugs on the [url=https://issues.frontierstore.net/reported-issues/planet-coaster-2]Issue Tracker[/url].

Thank you again and we look forward to putting Update 3 in your hands on March 20th!

Hayo Park Managers! 

We’re thrilled to be launching our second major update for Planet Coaster 2! Kicking off our Spring Roadmap, Update 2 brings a variety of features to give you even more creativity and flexibility in your parks, including [b]ride synchronisation[/b], [b]interchangeable coaster cars[/b], [b]video billboards[/b], and [b]custom speakers[/b]! Additionally, we have [b]two[/b] new[b] ‘de-themed’[/b] standard versions of coasters ready for you to customise, a dizzying returning [b]Flat Ride[/b] which we’ve rebuilt from the original Planet Coaster, [b]new coaster customisations[/b], as well as [b]enhancements to guest navigation, UI, notifications, and more[/b].

notes.title: Update 1 & Enhanced Flume Behaviour
notes.notes:
Hayo Park Managers! 

We’re delighted to be sharing a closer look at some of the changes coming to Planet Coaster 2 as part of Update 1, which arrives on December 12th! 

Game Director, Rich Newbold and Senior Executive Producer, Adam Woods, are here to act as your guides, taking a closer look at the flume enhancements brought by Update 1 and giving a sneak peek at the progress of further enhancements coming in the future. 

Let’s slide in! 

[previewyoutube=ti7z4CCO6A8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Enhanced Flume Movement [/h2]
Update 1 brings changes and improvements to the appearance and movement of guests as they enjoy your flumes, introducing more natural and varied movement for guests. 

In this update you’ll notice that guests will now have a more natural oscillation as they make their way down flumes or slides, while inflatables will also have a more dynamic sense of motion. 

We’ve also added more movement, including increasing the amount of spin that rafts can have, as well as boosting the swing of guests, rafts, and mats, i.e. more movement up the sides of flumes. 

[previewyoutube=kwIP8D4fiAE;full][/previewyoutube]

A ‘bounce’ movement has also been added, meaning that guests, and their rafts and mats, can now hit and bounce off the sides of the flumes and slides, which in turn can add further spin to their animations. 

Update 1 also introduces the ability to allow multiple guests onto a flume at the same time, which can be easily controlled by configuring the Minimum Interval between guests in the flume settings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100725/acd4fed4460e80ed348dbc8cdade699fa217e9f7.jpg[/img]

[h2]What Else is Update 1 Bringing? [/h2]
Flumes aren’t the only area that we’ve enhanced. In fact, Update 1 is bringing so many changes that it’s difficult for us to cover everything here! 

Some highlights of Update 1 include: 

[list]
[*] Added new scenery pieces, including transparent glass, coaster supports and fireworks! 
[*] Removed the Workshop download limit on PC 
[*] Improved the User Interface and menus, including adding new Contextual Help buttons 
[*] Added an option for edge scrolling the camera with the mouse 
[*] Added separate loading and unloading stations for coasters and tracked rides 
[*] Updated harnesses/restraints on some coasters 
[*] Improved staff and guest behaviour, including fixes for Janitors not emptying bins and better navigation for guests 
[*] Increased the maximum length of the Draw Tool 
[*] Various bug fixes 
[/list]

You can find the full list of everything that will be changed or added with Update 1, [url=https://www.planetcoaster.com/updates/1-0-9]HERE[/url]. 

We’re continuing to review your feedback and comments and hope to address these in future updates, so please continue to share your thoughts. 

[h2]What’s Coming Down the Pipe (or Flume)? [/h2]
While we’re still working on further flume changes for future updates based on your feedback, we wanted to share a snapshot of our progress so far, including some changes to how guests behave on flumes in, let’s say, unconventional circumstances. 

For example, we’ve been working on additional movements including guest jettison, in which guests would be thrown from a flume or slide if they experience a high amount of vertical g-force, such as going over humps, or around sharp corners. 

[previewyoutube=Zde49dSIFZc;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also been working on adding more varied movement as guests travel through special pieces. The guest, raft or mat would travel down the special pieces based on the entry speed and angle, including being jettisoned from the piece if they were to enter too fast. 

We’re continuing to work on these changes and hope to share more details in the future. 

It has been a joy to see all your wonderful parks and creations come to life following the release of Planet Coaster 2 and we can’t wait to see what you’ll do with the changes brought by Update 1! 

Update 1 will be available for all players on December 12th.
